invalid_phone: Enter a valid mobile number, e.g. 05XXXXXXXX.
required_one_language: Enter the name in at least one language.
period_end_before_start: End date must be after the start date.
invalid_slug: Use lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes only.
positive_number: Enter a number greater than zero.
number_min: The number is below the minimum.
number_max: The number is above the maximum.
invalid_option: Choose one of the available options.
min_gt_max: The minimum is greater than the maximum.
field_ids_unique: Two fields share the same id.
invalid_dimensions: Enter a valid width and height in pixels.
invalid_condition: A condition must depend on an earlier choice or checkbox question and an existing value.
review_needs_deliverable: Reviews and approvals need a step that produces a deliverable.
dependency_cycle: Dependencies form a loop — a step waits for itself.
status_done_required: Keep at least one status in the “Done” category.
status_default_required: Pick one status for new tasks.
dates_order: The due date must be after the start date.
comment_required: Add your feedback so the team knows what to change.
invalid_channel: This KPI points at a channel that no longer exists.
duplicate_kpi: This KPI is already set for the same scope.
duplicate_date: The file has the same date more than once.
time_order: The end must be after the start.
contact_required: Add a phone number or an email.
stages_won_lost: A pipeline needs open stages, one Won and one Lost stage.
